subject: Startups
title: SoftBank's Vision Fund Gamble
description: A short lesson to help you apply SoftBank's Vision Fund Gamble.

hook.text: In 2017, Masayoshi Son raised a $100 billion fund—the largest VC fund in history. People thought it was insane.

buildup.text: The Vision Fund wrote massive checks: $10 billion to WeWork, billions to Uber, DoorDash, and dozens of others.

discovery.text: Son's strategy was to fund one winner in each category so heavily that competitors would surrender.

twist.text: WeWork's collapse and many other bets lost billions.

climax.text: Some hits like Coupang survived. But the fund proved that throwing money doesn't guarantee market dominance.

punchline.text: The biggest fund proved that size alone can't buy winners.

quiz.question: What was SoftBank's Vision Fund strategy?
options: Small bets across thousands of startups
Massive investments to help one winner dominate each category
